about: Blizzard-shipped music in SC2 5.0.16 data (sc2-game-data @ 7be8945) joined with audio measured from a 5.0.17 install. Tags: [blz] Blizzard data or Blizzard's own pages; [dev] composer statement; [wiki] fan wiki; [db] MusicBrainz; [mine] inference or measurement-based reading; [gemini] Gemini listening to the audio with no name or context (a model's hearing, not a source); [essentia] Essentia pretrained taggers, a weak cross-check. 'measured' fields come from the audio files themselves.

fields.soundtracks[]: one per id an agent can call. kind 'Soundtrack' = a CSoundtrack id for SoundtrackPlay/SoundtrackDefault (Play Soundtrack); kind 'Sound' = a Music-category CSound that no soundtrack plays, for SoundPlay or a CCutsceneNodeSound soundLink, or to wrap in your own CSoundtrack
fields.defined: G/ path and line of each definition (G/ = sc2-game-data @ 7be8945); the last one wins
fields.dependency / in_our_stack: the mod or campaign that defines it, and whether our maps' dependency stack (Core, Liberty, Liberty Campaign, Swarm, Swarm Campaign, Void, Void Campaign, NovaStoryAssets, VoidStory) loads it. map-local ids exist only inside that Blizzard map
fields.sounds: the CSound ids in its CueArray (master layer, slave layers) with their definitions
fields.assets: the music files those sounds can play; with several files the engine picks one per cue (Select: random unless Sequential/Shuffle)
fields.continuous / next / delay_s / select / l: raw CSoundtrack fields and a reading of them: 'once' (Continuous=0), 'once, then Next: X' (chains), 'repeats' (Continuous inherited 1; Delay = random gap between cues in seconds)
fields.origin / role / mission / scene_label: which release and situation the id belongs to (from its name and file; mission names from GameStrings), its role word (intro, main, event, outro, briefing, cutscene, boss, victory, ...), and the scene words in Blizzard's id
fields.used_in / used_in_count: where Blizzard's scripts or .SC2Cutscene files name the id (first 5), with the enclosing trigger function
fields.duration_s / duration_range_s / energy: measured from the files: mean and range of the pool, energy 1-5 (quintile of loudness 55%, onset density 30%, brightness 15% across all 707 measured files)
fields.mood / use_for / confidence / descriptio: mood words (from curated sources, Blizzard's file-name words, or the release palette) and scene tags; 'sourced' only when a [blz]/[dev]/[wiki] text describes that piece
fields.pieces[]: one per music file: measured loudness (LUFS, LRA), onset rate, tempo estimate and its strength, fades, peak position, shape and tempo words, the ids that play it (played_by) and the ids that play only it (exact_ids), origin release, album mapping and description where sourced
fields.origin_style: palette and instrumentation per release, with source
fields.pieces[].listened: [gemini] listening notes: kind, summary, mood, energy/tension/valence (1-5), tempo_bpm, pulse, instrumentation, style, vocals, arc, sections [{start mm:ss, description}], opening, ending, faction_feel, use_for, avoid_for. Use sections to line a cue up with cutscene beats.
fields.pieces[].model_tags: [essentia] top MTG-Jamendo moodtheme/instrument/genre tags, 0-1 probabilities (aggressive, happy, sad, relaxed, acoustic, electronic, voice), emoMusic valence/arousal (1-9), engagement. Generic on orchestral music; cross-check only.
fields.pieces[].check: present when Gemini and Essentia clearly disagree; listen before relying on this file's description
fields.pieces[].energy_measured: the earlier signal-based energy score (1-5); energy itself is Gemini's rating where heard
fields.pieces[].description_basis: sourced (Blizzard/composer/wiki words), listened (model) ([gemini]), or inferred ([mine], measurements and file names)
